instruction: Buy the highest-rated picture frame on amazon in 10-20 price range (ignoring tax and other fees) for each of my roommates and get them delivered to my home.
notes: Two information needs are modeled explicitly: the number of roommates (phone.search_contacts with relationship=roommate, encoded as the runtime quantity object used for the cart quantity) and the highest-rated picture frame in the 10-20 price range (amazon.search_products with product_type/min_price/max_price and sort_by=-rating; the top result becomes found-highest-rated). add_product_to_cart uses clear_cart_first=true so the order contains only the frames, matching the evaluation requirement that ordered items be exactly num_roommates picture frames at max rating. The home address id is resolved by reading supervisor.show_addresses and matching it against amazon.show_addresses (is-home marks the matching record; no address is added/modified). supervisor.complete_task takes the ordered product/quantity/address as record parameters (no answer, since the task is not a question) and is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action. Static init facts (search-spec, count-result, search-result, clear-first, is-home, username-for) only bind the planner to the right literal/runtime objects.
